changelog: Fixed desktop PCs disappearing after a resource restart (automatic client sync on startup).
Fixed Tier 1 mission level requirements: whois command is now available from level 1 and active mission commands bypass level locks.
Terminal overhaul: toolbar, right-click menu, persistent history with Ctrl+R search, ghost suggestions, column completion, aliases, echo, copy and timestamp commands.
Fixed mouse text selection in the terminal (drag, double-click word, triple-click line).
You can now select text and use Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V in the terminal and in every window.
Tutorial: closing the terminal during the command part now restarts that part cleanly with its instructions.
Windows-style desktop on the PC tower (centered taskbar, start menu grid, Windows lock screen) and a hacker Linux look on the laptop (top panel, terminal boot).
New 'Match device' wallpaper, used by default.
Fixed a game crash when placing the shop NPC with the placement tool.
Co-op: invite up to 3 players on a contract, each with their own part of the job and a shared payout.
Player vs player intrusions on placed PCs, with live owner alerts, firewall, decoy files and an intrusion log.
Anonymous hacker forum, player market with escrow, and contracts posted by players.
Field missions (USB key on a server rack, capture box near a building, kiosk repair), with points placed in game.
City effects: temporary camera access, neighbourhood blackout and traffic light disruption, plus exports for other scripts.
CTF events launched by staff or scheduled weekly, with a live leaderboard and rewards, and 3 new terminal mini-games.
Darknet, crypto wallet, darknet software, desktop hardware components and police Cyber-crime tools (1.1.0).
Laptop and placeable desktop PC running ACN OS, procedural missions, tutorial, shop and full in-game configuration (1.0.0).
